\begin{document}
For an ideal gas heated from $T_1 > 0$ to $T_2 > 0$ at constant volume the entropy grows by
$C_V\ln T_2/T_1$, which we split as
\begin{equation}
C_V \ln T_2/T_1 = C_V\ln T_2 - C_V\ln T_1 .
\label{eq:s}
\end{equation}
At the magic angle,
\begin{equation}
\cos\pi/3 = \frac{1}{2} .
\label{eq:c}
\end{equation}
